description: Current implementation audit, not independent proof of game correctness
evidenceEncoding: Each resolvedStatContext field ending Ref indexes the same-named pools array, except enemyRef which refers to setup.enemy. Trigger-only and minBreakthrough metadata is omitted after resolution. Damage action, resolved stats/effects, expected channels, and active stacks are retained for every hit. inputContext is the public damage API input; resolvedStatContext is inspection-only after action-stat resolution.
